profile.summary: Senior software engineer at Oracle. Previously at IBM.

positions.locationName: Yorktown Heights, New York, United States

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · GraphQL · Go (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Node.js · Agile · Docker · Elasticsearch · Kubernetes · OpenShift · Microservices · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Cloud Computing · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · DevOps · TypeScript · GraphQL · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a team of four with the primary responsibility of developing and integrating multiple python modules for aerospace-industry software applications.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Provided office hours throughout the semester to guide graduate students in discrete mathematics (Spring 2019) and algorithms (Summer 2019) fundamentals. Graded and gave feedback to students on assignments, projects, and exams.

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description: Performed various audits for a broad range of clients in different industries. Primarily worked with clients and evaluated the companies against SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO compliance requirements. Responsible for all aspects of the audit including process meetings, testing internal controls, document preparation, and delivering the consolidated audit findings reports.

positions.title: Advisory Services - IT Risk and Assurance
positions.description: Performed reviews and testing of IT general and application controls for SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) audits. Worked with many clients in the financial services industry. Prepared quarterly reconciliations of clients' general ledger and trial balances using Audit Command Language (ACL).

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: Aided in transitioning the company's outdated intranet, to a new, responsive intranet on a team of 3 using HTML, CSS, and a content management tool called DotNetNuke.

positions.title: Blue Hens Mentor
positions.description: Mentored freshman student-athletes throughout their first year at Delaware by discussing monthly  academic goals and time management techniques.
